reply.text:
Good on you for wanting him in there with you. At 11, I'd want his doctor or pediatrician to weigh in before he starts a lifting routine, so that's the first stop, and I won't build him a program or session until a parent and his doctor have talked it through.

In the meantime, the easy win is having him come along and learn to move well. Showing him how you warm up, how you set up, and how you treat the gym is a good first lesson.

I'm glad to keep building your own training in the meantime.
